translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Anjla' nox̱ee to yish dii ba biyesh
Na'ch ble'id' sto anjl, beṉ' nap yeḻ' wak xen, chetje' yabana' zindobe' to bej. Yic̱hje'na' xoa to betyaa, na' cho'alawe'na' chep cheeni'n ka wbilla', na' ṉi'eka' nakgakan ka beḻ yi' dii chzolla'.
Na' nox̱ee to yish dii ba biyesh, na' bzoe' ṉi'e de shḻina' lo nisdo'na' na' de robesa' bzoe'n lo yell-liona'.
Na' besyaadie' zillj inlleb ka chosyaa to bell. Na' ka besyee, wṉe wziwaa gall shii.
Na' ka biyoll wṉe wziwaa gall shii, na'ch nan wzej' daa wnagakan. Per benid' wṉe to beṉ' yabana', na' wne' nad': ―Bi wzejo' daa wna wziwaa, san wlooshawaan ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'na'.
Na' anjla', beena' ble'id' nzoa ṉi'ena' tḻaa lo nisdo'na' na' daa zi tḻaa lo yell-liona', bḻis nee de shḻina' yabalə

na' bzoe' de tasc̱hiw beena' zoa zejḻi kaṉi, beena' bx̱e bsil yabana' na' yog'ḻoḻ daa llia xaninna', na' yell-lioni na' yog'ḻoḻ daa de lawinna', na' nisdo'na' na' yog'ḻoḻ daa lle' ḻo'inna', na' wne': ―Aga chllach gak daa llia bia' gak.
San kat' wkwell anjl, beṉ' gállina', trompet c̱he'na', na' yiyoll yido gak yog'ḻoḻ daa bllia Chioza' bia' gak, kon ka golle' dii beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa wne' kani'yi.
Na' sto shii benid' shii beena' wṉe yabana', na' wne' nad': ―Wyaj kwit anjla', beena' nzoa ṉi'ena' lo nisdo'na' na' lo yell-liona', na' jaxi' yisha' daa nox̱ee.
Na' wya' kwit anjla' na' biṉabidee yisha'. Na' wne' nad': ―Ni den, wdawan. Na' idawilon' zix̱ sia ka shin basera', per ḻoo ḻi'ona' yiyakan zic̱hj zḻa'.
Na' bikaa yisha' lo na' anjla' na' wdawa'n. Na' bdawidaan zix̱ sia ka shin basera', per ka bidon wdaw' na' biyakan zic̱hj zḻa' ḻoo ḻi'ana'.
Na' wne' nad': ―Chonan byen wi'o dill' daa na Chioza' gak c̱he beṉ'ka' lle' yellka', na' naciónka', na' beṉ' chṉe wde wdeli dill', na' beṉ' wṉabia'ka'.
